rules.text: hamzat al-qat' (a genuine glottal-stop hamza) and hamzat al-wasl (the seated helper alif, ٱ, pronounced only in isolation) are DISTINCT initial-hamza classes
the seat and its exact vocalization must be WRITTEN evidence -- normalisation (which regularly strips or unifies hamza seats) can never decide this on its own
a bare initial alif with no hamza mark at all is unresolved: it abstains rather than defaulting to either class
